SourcedEntity.description: A typed entity extracted from caller-supplied text only.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. service, location, document, person_name
type.title: Type

source.description: Which request field the entity was taken from

SourcedEntity.title: SourcedEntity

SourcedStatement.description: A fact or observation with provenance.

source.description: Which request field the statement was taken from

SourcedStatement.title: SourcedStatement

description:
Canonical serialized output passed to later agents.

Downstream components must consume this object, not terminal prose or raw model text.

contract_version.description: Intent contract version. Must match the request (1.0).
contract_version.title: Contract Version

request_id.description: Same ID as the corresponding IntentRequest
request_id.title: Request Id

original_goal.description: User goal preserved for this run
original_goal.title: Original Goal

normalized_goal.description: Concise restatement of the user goal without added facts
normalized_goal.title: Normalized Goal

service_name.description: Likely government service name, or null if not identified
service_name.title: Service Name

document_type.description: Likely document or certificate type, or null if not identified
document_type.title: Document Type

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction only when explicitly present in the request or supplied context
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

stated_facts.description: Facts that were explicitly stated by the caller
stated_facts.title: Stated Facts

ambiguities.description: Unresolved items that block a confident classification
ambiguities.title: Ambiguities

clarification_questions.description: Short questions asked only when needed to identify the task or service
clarification_questions.title: Clarification Questions

urgency.description: Explicit urgency if stated; otherwise null. Do not infer from unrelated wording.
urgency.title: Urgency

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence that the classification is correct, from 0 to 1
confidence.title: Confidence

title: IntentResult
